The plate spans roughly 350 px, which I take as about 26 cm, so about 13 px per cm. The scrambled egg pile is about 185 px by 100 px, or roughly 14 cm by 8 cm. That is about 80 cm² of footprint with a height of about 2 cm, giving a volume of around 100 cm³ at loose packing, so about 80 g. The small separate piece near the top adds about 5 g, for a total of about 85 g.
